title: Family Visitation Plan
intro: Write the visit before you drive there. Decide what you will bring, what you will not promise, and exactly when you will leave.
privacy: Saved in protected storage on this device for your signed-in account.
coreMessage: Families do not lose people in group. They lose them in the parking lot after visiting hours.
coreSupport: The parking lot is part of the visit. Back the program, end on time, and leave the property without reopening the going-home conversation.
readyBody: Keep this plan open. Follow the facility's rules, support the program, and leave at the written time.
notReadyBody: A loving visit is not an improvised discharge conversation. Complete every field and commitment first.
loadErrorTitle: Protected plan could not be opened
loadErrorBody: Editing is blocked so an unreadable saved plan cannot be overwritten.
saveError: Not saved—retry before relying on this plan
clearBody: This permanently removes the saved visit from protected storage on this device.

fields.carePackagePlaceholder: Example: socks, stamps, and facility-approved items
fields.parkingLotPlaceholder: Who walks to which car, what you will say, and how you leave without renegotiating

commitmentHint: Confirm each boundary before leaving home.

commitments.writtenBeforeDrive: We wrote the visit before driving there.
commitments.noCash: No cash in the card—and no cash handed over during or after the visit.
commitments.noRoomReady: We will not say “your room is ready,” especially to someone age 18 or older.
commitments.noOutsideNegotiation: We will not pull them outside or into the parking lot to relitigate going home.
commitments.backProgram: We will see them, listen with care, and back the treatment program.
commitments.leaveOnTime: We will end the visit and leave at the written time.
commitments.approvedCarePackage: The care package is socks, stamps, and facility-approved basics—not a way around the house or program.
commitments.parkingLotExit: We have a parking-lot exit plan and will not turn departure into another treatment decision.

facilityRule: Facility rules come first. Confirm approved items and visitation procedures directly with the program.
footer: Warmth and boundaries belong in the same visit. You can love them without undoing the structure holding them today.
